adjudication.rationale: The finding claims there is “no spec for EmbeddableHost” and that the core acceptance criterion has “zero test coverage,” but the diff adds `spec/models/embeddable_host_spec.rb` which explicitly tests host normalization (trimming http/https/paths) and `record_for_host`/`host_allowed?` behavior. It also updates `spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb` to fabricate an `embeddable_host` and asserts `TopicEmbed.import` creates a topic in `embeddable_host.category`, directly covering the change from `SiteSetting.embed_category` to `eh.try(:category_id)`. While it’s true the new controller specs are minimal and there’s no migration spec, the finding’s key assertions are contradicted by the diff.
